underlying_goal: Fix Spring Boot application startup failure by properly separating bean scanning between dynamic-indexer and legacy-sync modules using conditional property-based activation
friction_detail: User asked for approach B (ConditionalOnProperty on existing @Service) but Claude implemented approach A (new @Configuration classes), requiring a rollback and redo.
brief_summary: User needed to separate Spring Boot bean activation between two bootstrap modules; after one wrong implementation attempt, Claude successfully applied app.mode-based ConditionalOnProperty across 5 services and 2 yml files.
